workflows.description: local mathlib, MathformerLib, web grounding, import, and compatibility controls before prompts rely on APIs.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered mathlib_grounding_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared mathlib_grounding_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by mathlib_grounding_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Resolve a Lean concept demand against a fixed mathlib revision, verify applicable declarations, and produce a usable API and import plan.
reasoning_projection.name: GroundLeanAPIs

occurrences.rationale: Resolve requested concepts, ambiguity, proof roles, and navigation bounds.
Observe a version-stamped declaration and import snapshot.
Search local indexes, hierarchy neighborhoods, and official-source fallbacks for candidate declarations.
Verify snapshot-bound declaration applicability and retain the supporting evidence.
Assess whether every demanded concept has verified coverage or an explicit gap.
Select declarations and narrow imports while keeping unresolved gaps visible.
Check selected APIs in the intended import and namespace context.
Return the verified API plan together with coverage, compatibility, and explicit gaps.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: snapshot-bound API applicability and import planning
